mapper.select: with T01 as ( -- Danh sách xuất kho ra MA select A.slip_no, count(A.lot_no) total_lot_request, A.created_at from pur_wh_records A where 1=1 and A.record_type = 'XPA' and A.date between date_format(#{dateRange[0]}, '%Y-%m-%d') and date_format(#{dateRange[1]}, '%Y-%m-%d') group by A.slip_no ), T02 as ( -- Danh sách đã nhận select A.req_no, count(A.lot_no) total_lot_receive from pur_wh_records A where 1=1 and A.record_type = 'RNP' and A.date between date_format(#{dateRange[0]}, '%Y-%m-%d') and date_format(#{dateRange[1]}, '%Y-%m-%d') group by A.req_no ), T03 as ( select T01.slip_no request_no, T01.total_lot_request, T02.total_lot_receive, T01.created_at from T01 left join T02 on T01.slip_no = T02.req_no ) select T03.*, A.line, A.parent from T03 left join pur_wh_headers A on T03.request_no = A.reg_no order by T03.created_at desc

with T01 as ( -- Danh sách xuất kho ra MA select * from pur_wh_records A where 1=1 and A.record_type = 'XPA' and A.slip_no = #{requestNo} ), T02 as ( -- Danh sách đã nhận select * from pur_wh_records A where 1=1 and A.record_type = 'RNP' and A.req_no = #{requestNo} ), T03 as ( select T02.id, T01.parent, T01.model, A.lot_group, T01.lot_no, ABS(T01.qty) qty, T02.req_no, B.name receiver_name, T01.wh_user_code, T02.lot_no lot_no_receive, T02.created_at, T02.updated_at, T02.date, T02.receiver, T01.sender from T01 left join T02 on T01.lot_no = T02.lot_no left join lots A on T01.lot_no = A.lot_no left join users B on T02.receiver = B.username ) select T03.id, T03.model, T03.lot_group, T03.lot_no,T03.lot_no_receive, T03.receiver_name, T03.qty, T03.date, T03.receiver, T03.created_at, T03.updated_at, T03.req_no, T03.sender, T03.wh_user_code, case when T03.receiver is null then 0 when T03.receiver = "" then 0 else 1 end status, case when T03.receiver is null then 'Not yet' when T03.receiver = "" then 'Not yet' else 'Received' end status_name from T03;
